# Shared instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before direct PE application work. It is the canonical repository workflow.

Use [.agents/skills/direct-pe-x64/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/direct-pe-x64/SKILL.md) for raw-byte Windows x64 executable creation, selective module inspection, patching and debugging. Direct EXE edits are permitted. tools/pe_workbench.py is an optional frontend for overview/graph/named retrieval and managed patches. Keep embedded descriptions concise and retain one bounded work directory.
